_about: The Workshop (workshop.html): every technology Machina Christi uses or plans to use. One pane each, in tiers from the visitor's hands down to the workbench. status is 'live' or 'planned' (planned panes name their roadmap phase). touches lists the panes it connects to; the page lights them together. Each tier's story is what its card reads. To add a technology, add a pane here. A new tier also needs its colour (--<tier-id>) in workshop.html.

tiers.name: In your hands
tiers.story: It begins in your hands. Your own browser draws Eden, sings Camino's chant and reads the prayers aloud, with nothing to install.

tiers.name: At the door
tiers.story: Every request passes the door first. Cloudflare and the security headers decide what may come in, and how.

tiers.name: The house
tiers.story: Inside is the house: the pages themselves, and a small API that wakes only when it is called.

tiers.name: The storeroom
tiers.story: Below it lies the storeroom. Today it keeps the API's own state; soon it will hold the saints and the prayers.

tiers.name: Messengers
tiers.story: The messengers are still clear glass: a voice for the prayers, a guard for the prayer wall, and candles shared live.

tiers.name: The watch
tiers.note: keeping an eye on it all
tiers.story: The watch keeps an eye on it all: every page view and error counted, and an alarm at the first dollar spent.

tiers.name: The workbench
tiers.note: how it is made and kept
tiers.story: And at the foot is the workbench, where every change is written, tested and sent up through all the rest.

panes.name: three.js
panes.what: A 3D graphics library for the web.
panes.here: Draws Eden, its garden, creatures and light, and up Jacob's ladder a first heaven where the saints of the calendar stand, right in your browser.

panes.name: Canvas
panes.what: The browser's 2D drawing surface.
panes.here: Camino is drawn frame by frame on a canvas: the road, the pilgrim, the wayside crosses.

panes.name: Web Audio
panes.what: The browser's sound engine.
panes.here: Camino's chant, Eden's ambience and heaven's held chord are composed live in code. There are no recordings.

panes.name: Speech synthesis
panes.what: The voices built into your device.
panes.here: Reads the prayers on Pray aloud, in Thai and in English, and a Logos card's name if its recording can't play.

panes.name: Cloudflare
panes.what: A global network that stands in front of the site.
panes.here: Encrypts every connection, caches what it can, counts visits without cookies, and turns away floods: more than 20 requests to the API in 10 seconds from one address is refused.

panes.name: Security headers
panes.what: Rules sent with every page that tell your browser what is allowed.
panes.here: No framing by other sites, no plugins, no hidden permissions, and a strict content policy, enforced: a page may only load what it is meant to.

panes.name: Static Web Apps
panes.what: Azure's host for websites.
panes.here: Serves every page of Machina Christi on the free plan, and builds a preview copy of the site for each proposed change.

panes.name: Functions
panes.what: Code that runs only when it is called.
panes.here: The API at api.machinachristi.com: the Church's day and its saint, the prayers and their recordings, and search, which it also fills with cards. It sleeps when no one calls, and only Cloudflare may reach it.

panes.name: Managed identity
panes.what: An identity Azure gives a service, so it can prove who it is without a password.
panes.here: How the API reaches the saints, the prayers, the recordings, the search index and its telemetry, and how the deploy robot signs in. There are no keys or passwords to leak.

panes.name: Entra ID
panes.what: Microsoft's sign-in and access service.
panes.here: Will guard a small admin page for editing the saints and keeping the prayer wall.

panes.name: Blob Storage
panes.what: Azure's file storage.
panes.here: Holds the API's code, the saints snapshot and the prayers' recordings. Its keys are switched off: only identities with a role can enter, and visitors hear the recordings through the API.

panes.name: Azure SQL
panes.what: A relational database.
panes.here: Holds the saints of Ordo: feasts, people, patronages, every fact with its source. Visitors never wait on it: once a week, and after every change, the API copies what the site needs into a snapshot. Only the API's private network may reach it. Eden's heaven names the same saints from the copy that ships with the site (names, titles and feast days only), so it never wakes the database either.

panes.name: Cosmos DB
panes.what: A database of documents.
panes.here: Holds the prayers of Pray, each in Thai, English and transliteration, with its recordings and line timings. Free for life, and capped so it can never bill.

panes.name: AI Search
panes.what: Search as a service.
panes.here: Lets you search saints, prayers and every page at once, in English or Thai, forgiving a typo. The API fills it with a card for each, and is the only one that may ask it; its keys are switched off.

panes.name: AI Speech
panes.what: Speech made and heard by machine.
panes.here: Recorded every prayer in a natural Thai and English voice, at normal speed and slowly, with each line's exact start so the highlight follows the voice. Its own listening checked every Thai line, and a short respelling list now helps the voice say the few rare words it misread. It also says the name of every Thai letter on Logos's flash cards. Next it will listen as learners practise saying them.

panes.name: Content Safety
panes.what: A service that screens text for harm.
panes.here: Will read prayer intentions before they appear on the prayer wall.

panes.name: SignalR
panes.what: Live messages between visitors.
panes.here: Will let you see other visitors' candles as fireflies in Eden.

panes.name: Application Insights
panes.what: Azure's monitoring for apps and pages.
panes.here: Counts page views, time on page and errors, with no cookies and nothing that follows you, and watches every API request.

panes.name: Log Analytics
panes.what: Where telemetry is kept and questioned, in a language called KQL.
panes.here: Two stores, each with a hard daily limit, so the site stays inside its free allowance.

panes.name: Budget
panes.what: A spending alarm.
panes.here: Rings at the first dollar. Everything here is built to run on free allowances, so any spending at all is a signal.

panes.name: GitHub
panes.what: Where the code lives.
panes.here: All of Machina Christi is public. Every change arrives as a pull request.

panes.name: GitHub Actions
panes.what: Automation that runs on every change.
panes.here: Tests each change, previews its effect on Azure, and on merge deploys the site and the API. The API signs in to Azure without any stored password.

panes.name: Bicep
panes.what: Azure's language for writing infrastructure down as code.
panes.here: The API and everything around it in Azure is described in Bicep, so it can be rebuilt from the code rather than from memory.

panes.name: Playwright
panes.what: A robot that uses web pages the way you do.
panes.here: Before anything merges, more than 150 tests walk every page: Eden must grow, Camino must play, search must find the saints, no security rule may break, and this map must match what is built.

panes.name: Azure DevOps
panes.what: Boards for planning work.
panes.here: Each release of the site, including this roadmap's eight phases, is planned there as work items.

panes.name: Claude
panes.what: An AI assistant made by Anthropic.
panes.here: Writes much of the code beside the builder, one conversation at a time, and each week tends Eden with a new detail drawn from Scripture.
